title: Rushin' Outta Russia
overview: As Sugimoto and the members of the 7th Division head back into Japanese territory, they're attacked by a sniper.

title: Cocoon
overview: Kadokura challenges Sekiya, one of the tattooed prisoners, to a deadly game in order to save the life of Hijikata.

title: The Smell of Sulfur
overview: The members of the 7th hunt a strange man at the Noboribetsu hot springs.

title: Spoiled Rich Kid
overview: When Koito was fourteen years old, he had a chance encounter with Lieutenant Tsurumi. When he was sixteen years old, he was kidnapped by men who spoke Russian, and only Lieutenant Tsurumi could save him.

title: Cinematograph
overview: Asirpa looks for a way to pass down Ainu culture to later generations.

title: Sweet Lies
overview: Sugimoto and Asirpa prepare to meet the main unit of the 7th Division.

title: Fleeing Karafuto
overview: Asirpa comes face to face with the 7th Division, and doesn't like what she sees.

title: Brown Bear Man
overview: The crew meets a very unusual character in the Hokkaido woods, who says he's being stalked by a bear.

title: Partner in Crime
overview: Shiraishi comes up with a new way to find the gold while the 7th Division goes after a serial killer in Sapporo.

title: Perfect Mother
overview: Tanigaki goes after Inkarmat, who is pregnant with his child and being held by the 7th Division.

title: Steamship
overview: The steamship that Sugimoto's party is riding on is attacked by Botaro the pirate.

title: Discharge
overview: Usami and Kikuta search out a bizarre serial killer in Sapporo while Sugimoto fights a desperate underwater battle.

title: The Vanished Kamuy
overview: Usami and Kikuta remain on the hunt for the killer as Botaro tries to unravel the mystery of Asirpa and Sugimoto's relationship.
